name: Axioma AI
author: Axioma AI

sections.description:
AxiomaBot: Trained on your data, powered by LLMs – instant access to the knowledge you need. Build a custom GPT, embed it on your website and let it handle customer support, lead generation, engage with your users, and more.
With this plugin, you can embed your AxiomaBot chatbot directly into your WordPress site.
This plugin utilizes Axioma AI services to deploy a pre-trained chatbot on your website, leveraging the data you’ve uploaded to the Axioma Bot application. For more information on privacy, and terms of service, please refer to our dedicated sections on these topics.
sections.faq:
How do I initialize my chatbot?

  1. Install this plugin to your WordPress website.
  2. Copy your Chatbot ID from AxiomaBot chatbot settings tab.
  3. Navigate to “Settings” tab under the “Axiomabot” menu in the sidebar of your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Paste your Chatbot ID into the designated field.
  5. Click “Save Changes”.
